description: Feature 1 — accurate multi-language interviewer-voice detection, end to end across both repos. Expand the backend language registry to the ~20-code set from design.md, thread a user-selected language set from the Interview-tab dropdown through /ws/audio -> ai.transcribe + ai.detect_language and through /ws/interview -> InterviewSession so each finalized utterance is tagged with its detected language and answered in that language (session not locked to one language), and fix non-Latin question detection. This is the foundational feature; FEAT-002 reuses the same frontend files and session start-frame path and MUST run after it. All language edits plus their test updates are in this feature. Grounded in the verified source: ai.ask has no language channel (api_ask appends a directive), ws_interview starts a session only when session is None, audio.js reads only msg.speaker/msg.text, _DEFAULTS.detectionConfidenceThreshold==0.6, question_detector has _looks_incomplete + heuristic_detect (no _looks_complete there), interview_session has a separate static _looks_complete.
steps: interview_config.py: replace the single-entry SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES with the full registry from design.md 'Canonical language registry' (each entry {name, native, default_locale}). Keep normalize_language/speech_locale_for contracts. Add normalize_language_set(values, fallback='en')->list[str] (normalize+dedupe, drop unknowns, guarantee at least [fallback]) and normalize_language_in_set(value, allowed, fallback)->str. Add optional defaultLanguages to _DEFAULTS + INTERVIEW_DEFAULT_LANGUAGES in _ENV_MAP (comma-split) + dataclass field + a `languages` property; keep defaultLanguage/defaultSpeechLocale = en/en-IN.

ai.py: replace single-entry LANGUAGE_NAMES with a lookup into interview_config.SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES (defensive import, local fallback {'en':'English'}). Promote _language_instruction to a PUBLIC language_instruction(language) that pins the resolved language name and adds 'Match the language of the interviewer's question exactly'; keep _language_instruction = language_instruction as an alias. Add transcribe_detailed(audio_bytes, filename='chunk.webm', model=None, language=None, candidate_languages=None)->(text, detected_lang|None) using response_format='verbose_json' when possible, falling back to plain text + None; reimplement transcribe() to call it and drop the language (text-only signature unchanged). Add detect_language(text, candidate_languages, model=None)->str (one set-constrained chat call; never raises; coerces to candidate_languages[0] on any error/unparseable/off-set).

question_detector.py: in _looks_incomplete extend ends_terminal to include ？ ؟ ।; in heuristic_detect extend the `endswith('?') -> score += 0.55` rule to also match ？ ؟ । (core non-Latin fix). Change QuestionDetector.detect(self, text) to detect(self, text, language=None); pin use_llm = self.config.useLlmClassifier and self.ai_module is not None and base.complete and (lang != 'en' or self.AMBIGUOUS_LOW <= base.confidence <= self.AMBIGUOUS_HIGH). When use_llm is False and lang != 'en': if base.complete and (text ends in ? ？ ؟ । ! . OR len(normalized) >= self.config.minTranscriptChars), return DetectionResult(is_question=True, confidence=max(base.confidence, self.config.detectionConfidenceThreshold), category=base.category, complete=True, source='heuristic'). en path unchanged.

interview_session.py: InterviewSession.__init__ gains languages: list[str]|None, resolves self.languages (via normalize_language_set) + self.default_language (= languages[0] when provided else today's resolved language), keeps self.language/self.speech_locale as status default. add_transcript(..., language=None) carries the TRUE per-utterance language on the pending buffer and onto the finalized turn. Question gains a language attr + in to_dict(). _finalize_utterance sets Question.language = normalize_language_in_set(turn_language, self.languages, fallback=self.default_language), calls self.detector.detect(text, language=turn_language) with the TRUE code, includes language in QUESTION_DETECTED, and TRANSCRIPT_FINAL includes the TRUE per-turn language. _generate passes question.language (not self.language) to ai.answer_interview_question[_stream]. Extend InterviewSession._looks_complete terminal tuple with ？ ؟ ।. SessionManager.start_session(..., languages=None) threads the set. Do NOT add any set_candidate_profile setter.

server.py: api_health adds native to each entry ({code,name,native,locale}; locale stays the wire key). ws_audio: when the envelope carries languages, resolve via normalize_language_set, call ai.transcribe_detailed (single hard hint only when exactly one selected; else none), run ai.detect_language fallback when STT returns no in-set language, set true_lang honestly, add language/speech_locale to the transcript reply, and for a single selected language always tag that code even when STT/classifier return nothing; when languages is ABSENT call the existing ai.transcribe() path exactly as today (Audio tab untouched). ws_interview: parse languages on start, pass to start_session, echo languages in SESSION_STARTED, parse optional per-frame language on transcript frames and pass to add_transcript; leave the `if mtype in (None,'transcript'):` catch-all unchanged (no profile branch). api_interview_start (REST): accept languages and pass through. api_ask: accept optional language; when present and normalize_language(language) is a supported non-en code, system_prompt = (data.get('system_prompt') or ai_helper.ANSWER_SYSTEM_PROMPT) + '\n' + ai_helper.language_instruction(normalize_language(language)) passed to ask/ask_stream (APPEND, never replace); absent/en => body byte-for-byte today's.

interview.js: add a SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES mirror constant (code/name/native/locale) matching the backend. start(opts) stores opts.languages (empty => ['en']). Extract the start-frame object from connectIvWs().ws.onopen into buildStartFrame() returning { type:'start', session_id: state.sessionId, candidate_profile: state.candidateProfile, language: state.language || undefined, languages: state.languages } and _sendStartFrame() = ivSend(buildStartFrame()); onopen calls _sendStartFrame(). Add languages on every /ws/audio send envelope in the sttSend({speaker:'them',audio,filename,languages}) call. In /ws/audio onmessage read msg.language and forward it on the /ws/interview transcript frame and onTranscript. In handleIvEvent read language on SESSION_STARTED (store state.languages), TRANSCRIPT_FINAL, QUESTION_DETECTED, passing through to callbacks. Add setLanguages/getLanguages and setCandidateProfile/getCandidateProfile accessors. Expose _sendStartFrame, _ivSend: ivSend, _sttSend: sttSend in the existing Testing hooks block. No sendProfile()/no {type:'profile'} frame.

index.html: in the #view-interview .actions row add a <details>-based checkbox dropdown #iv-langs with summary label #iv-lang-summary (one checkbox per registry language). In initInterviewUI(): build the dropdown from the registry; on first Interview-tab open call /api/health and reconcile by code (union; backend labels/locale win for shared codes; backend-only codes added; frontend-only codes dropped; health-unreachable => hardcoded mirror + console warning). Persist selected codes to localStorage key iv.languages on change; on restore intersect with reconciled codes, default ['en'] when empty. Add languages: getSelectedLanguages() to startOpts(). Render a small per-turn language badge from msg.language; extend #iv-locale to show default locale + selected-set count. No changes to Answer/Gallery/Audio controllers.

test/interview.test.js: extend with SESSION_STARTED languages adoption; TRANSCRIPT_FINAL/QUESTION_DETECTED language surfaced; start() normalizes empty languages => ['en']; setLanguages/getLanguages + setCandidateProfile/getCandidateProfile round-trip; and the seam test: define WebSocket.OPEN = 1, seed state.ivWs={readyState:1, send:s=>captured.push(JSON.parse(s))} (and state.sttWs), set state.languages/state.candidateProfile, call IV._sendStartFrame(), assert captured frame has type:'start', languages, language===languages[0], candidate_profile. No socket opened, no fetch.

Backend language tests: re-point tests/test_language_default.py (normalize_language params -> ('fr','fr'),('zh-CN','zh'),('xx','en'); speech_locale_for('fr')=='fr-FR' and ('xx')=='en-IN'; prompt test -> 'French' in _build_interview_prompt('general','fr') and 'respond in English' in (...,'xx'); start-probe {'language':'fr'} -> {'language':'xx'}->'en'; keep bare-{} English-default asserts). In tests/test_interview_session.py add a dedicated FakeAI.detect_language(self,text,candidate_languages,model=None) stub (returns in-set code, default candidate_languages[0]) distinct from ask(), plus a multi-language carry test (languages=['hi','en']: a 'hi' turn -> last_language=='hi', then an 'en' turn -> 'en'). Add tests/test_language_registry.py for normalize_language_set/normalize_language_in_set + full-registry locales. Extend tests/test_question_detector.py: non-Latin ？ ؟ । with LLM disabled clears 0.6; non-English with an LLM stub detected. Extend tests/test_interview_api.py: /api/health entries include native; /api/interview/start with languages echoes the set.
acceptance_criteria: `/Users/pranay/Desktop/Pranay/Projects/In-Queue/screen_shot/.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/ -q` passes (existing + new language tests), run after `.venv/bin/pip install pytest`.
From overlay_app, `npm test` passes including the new SESSION_STARTED/language and _sendStartFrame seam assertions.

A Hindi-tagged utterance yields Question.language=='hi' and ai.answer_interview_question is called with language='hi'; a later English turn in the same session uses 'en' (verified in test_interview_session.py).
A bare non-Latin question (e.g. 'क्लोज़र क्या है।') with the LLM disabled is detected with confidence >= 0.6 (verified in test_question_detector.py).
Audio tab path is untouched: when a /ws/audio envelope has no `languages`, server.py calls the existing ai.transcribe() and the transcript reply is unchanged.
findings:
IMPLEMENTED + VERIFIED. 91 backend pytest pass (after `.venv/bin/pip install pytest`), `import server` smoke ok with no OPENAI_API_KEY, `node --check interview.js preload.js` ok, `npm test` 16/16 pass. No .env/app.db/screenshots/logs touched. No new backend deps added (pypdf/python-docx are FEAT-002 scope and were NOT added here). Both repos on ObservationsAtul.

BACKEND new/changed helper names + signatures FEAT-002 / integration will reuse:
- interview_config.py: SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES now 20 codes, each {name, native, default_locale}. NEW: normalize_language_set(values, fallback='en')->list[str] (dedupe+normalize, drop unknowns, never empty); normalize_language_in_set(value, allowed, fallback=None)->str (coerces off-set to fallback-in-allowed else allowed[0]). _DEFAULTS gained 'defaultLanguages':['en']; _ENV_MAP gained INTERVIEW_DEFAULT_LANGUAGES (comma-split, handled by _coerce list branch); InterviewConfig gained field defaultLanguages (default_factory list) + property `languages`. defaultLanguage/defaultSpeechLocale unchanged (en/en-IN).
- ai.py: NEW public language_instruction(language)->str (pins name + 'Match the language of the interviewer's question exactly'); _language_instruction = language_instruction alias kept. LANGUAGE_NAMES now built from registry via _language_names() with local {'en':'English'} fallback. NEW transcribe_detailed(audio_bytes, filename='chunk.webm', model=None, language=None, candidate_languages=None)->(text:str, detected_lang:str|None) using verbose_json then plain fallback; transcribe() reimplemented as text-only wrapper (signature unchanged). NEW detect_language(text, candidate_languages, model=None)->str (never raises; coerces off-set/unparseable/not-configured to candidate_languages[0]). NEW _normalize_detected_language(value)->str|None helper. Added module logger `log`.
- question_detector.py: _looks_incomplete ends_terminal + heuristic_detect's '?'->0.55 rule now also match ？ ؟ ।. QuestionDetector.detect(self, text, language=None): use_llm gate = useLlmClassifier and ai_module is not None and base.complete and (lang!='en' or AMBIGUOUS band); non-en LLM-unavailable lenient floor returns confidence=max(base, detectionConfidenceThreshold=0.6) for complete utterance ending in ? ？ ؟ । ! . OR >= minTranscriptChars.
- interview_session.py: InterviewSession.__init__ gained languages=None; self.languages (via _resolve_languages), self.default_language=languages[0], self.language=default (status). NEW helper _coerce_language_in_set(value)->str. Question gained .language attr + in to_dict(). add_transcript(..., language=None) carries true per-turn code via self._pending_language onto EOU candidate. _finalize_utterance(text, turn_language=None): true_lang used for detector.detect(text, language=true_lang) and TRANSCRIPT_FINAL 'language'; answer_lang=_coerce_language_in_set(true_lang) set as Question.language and in QUESTION_DETECTED. _generate passes question.language. _looks_complete terminal tuple extended with ？ ؟ ।. SessionManager.start_session(..., languages=None) threads through.
- server.py: module helpers NEW _normalize_language/_normalize_language_set/_speech_locale_for (defensive wrappers over interview_config). api_health language entries gained 'native' (wire key for locale stays 'locale'). ws_audio: when envelope has 'languages' -> transcribe_detailed (single hard hint only if exactly one selected) + detect_language fallback; reply gains 'language'+'speech_locale'; single-language always tagged; absent languages -> plain ai.transcribe() unchanged. ws_interview: parses 'languages' on start -> start_session, echoes 'languages' in SESSION_STARTED, parses per-frame 'language' -> add_transcript. api_interview_start (REST) accepts 'languages', echoes session.languages. api_ask accepts optional 'language' and APPENDS ai_helper.language_instruction(normalize_language(language)) to (data.system_prompt or ANSWER_SYSTEM_PROMPT) only for supported non-en; absent/en byte-for-byte today.

WIRE FIELDS ADDED (all optional, absent==today): /ws/audio send {..., languages:[codes]}; /ws/audio transcript reply {..., language, speech_locale}; /ws/interview start {..., languages}; SESSION_STARTED {..., languages}; /ws/interview transcript frame {..., language}; TRANSCRIPT_FINAL {..., language}; QUESTION_DETECTED {..., language}; REST /api/interview/start accepts+echoes languages; /api/ask accepts language.

FRONTEND (interview.js): NEW const SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES mirror (code/name/native/locale, 20 entries, matches backend). state.languages (default ['en']). start(opts) stores opts.languages (empty->['en']), state.language=languages[0]. NEW buildStartFrame()/sendStartFrame() extracted from connectIvWs onopen. sttSend envelope carries languages. /ws/audio onmessage reads msg.language, forwards on /ws/interview transcript frame + onTranscript. handleIvEvent reads languages on SESSION_STARTED (stores state.languages) and language on TRANSCRIPT_PARTIAL/FINAL + QUESTION_DETECTED. NEW accessors setLanguages/getLanguages, setCandidateProfile/getCandidateProfile, and IV.SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES. Testing hooks exposed: _sendStartFrame, _buildStartFrame, _ivSend, _sttSend (plus existing _handleIvEvent/_state).
- preload.js: askText extended to (text, tone, recordId, language) — language added to POST body only when defined (Answer tab 3-arg calls unaffected). parseResume NOT added (FEAT-002 scope).
- index.html: #iv-langs <details> checkbox dropdown + #iv-lang-summary + #iv-langs-list added to .actions row; initInterviewUI builds from IV.SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES, reconciles against /api/health supported_languages by code (backend wins, backend-only added, frontend-only dropped, health-unreachable -> mirror + console.warn), persists to localStorage 'iv.languages' (intersected with reconciled codes on restore, default ['en']). startOpts() adds languages:getSelectedLanguages(). Per-turn .qa-lang-badge rendered from transcript language; cards store .language and the retry askText passes it. #iv-locale now shows default speech locale + selected-language count. No Answer/Gallery/Audio controller changes.

DEVIATIONS: (1) index.html test seam harness fix: test/interview.test.js sandbox now sets WebSocketStub.OPEN=1 so the _sendStartFrame seam's seeded ws.readyState guard matches (design specified setting WebSocket.OPEN=1 in the sandbox; implemented on the stub ctor). (2) Frontend deepStrictEqual assertions on module-returned arrays use Array.from(...) to avoid vm cross-realm Array prototype mismatch. Neither affects production code. parseResume/resume_parser/requirements pins deferred to FEAT-002 as scoped.
